description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the correctness of keyboard loading and layout in the AnySoftKeyboard project, including validation of keyboard metadata, creation, and key positioning within the keyboard layout.

classes.name: LoadedKeyboardsVerificationTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the loading, creation, and layout of keyboards in the application.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard factory before each test.

methods.name: testAllKeyboardsHaveValidMetadata
methods.description: Checks that all available keyboard add-ons have valid metadata such as ID, name, description, and API version.

methods.name: testAllKeyboardsCanBeCreated
methods.description: Verifies that all add-ons can create keyboards for various modes and that these keyboards can load the test dimensions.

methods.name: testAllKeysAreInsideKeyboard
methods.description: Ensures that all keys within created keyboards are positioned within the keyboard's width and height bounds.
